baseline_notes.reference_adaptation: Odysseus workspace and agent concepts are retained as future boundaries, but the client shell is single-surface, touch-first, progressive-disclosure oriented, and intentionally lightweight for mobile PWA use.
baseline_notes.storage_notes: IndexedDB database mobile-agentic-ide, version 2, files and directories stores keyed by normalized relative path. Storage is same-origin and device-local; no backend sync is included. A portable .agent_state.json ledger is ensured on workspace load.
baseline_notes.agent_notes: Handover payload format mobile-agentic-ide.handover.v1 is model-neutral and includes agentState, files, diffs, sessionHistory and recent test logs. Provider keys and GitHub/Google OAuth tokens are kept in separate device-local IndexedDB vaults with local AES-GCM wrapping; this is not hardware-backed encryption. Workspace agent turns expose bounded file, command, code, and ecosystem tools and run for at most five tool rounds. External GitHub branch/commit/PR and Google Drive export mutations require explicit confirm: true. execute_command and execute_code use the WebAssembly.Memory-backed WasmContainer, PolyglotEngine, ModuleResolver, and ProcessManager. Verification runs after each tool operation and auto-correction can request at most three additional turns.
baseline_notes.pwa_notes: src/sw.ts is the service-worker source and public/sw.js is the production static asset. The worker caches the built shell and discovers generated bundle URLs from index.html; IndexedDB remains the offline workspace source of truth.
